fact: The Minister of Communications and Digital Technologies said in a written reply that SITA delivered 117 e-Services through 35 digital products to more than 30 government departments and public entities in 2025/26.
The Gauteng Department of e-Government said its 2025/26 annual report records 33 e-Services developed and enhanced during the year.
DCDT says it and SITA jointly developed the National e-Government Portal, hosted by SITA at eservices.gov.za, which gives access to e-Services.

fact: Home affairs minister Schreiber said the electronic travel authorisation (ETA) system, launched by President Ramaphosa on 12 August, is live for short-stay visa applications from 53 countries, at four international airports.
The minister says the National e-Government Portal developed through SITA carries 92 digitised government services.
The minister says the portal's services drew over 899,394 logins in the past year, with over 1.4 million registered users.
SITA's board chairperson told Parliament's committee that SITA has approximately 170 external e-services, which it plans to surface on a mobile platform.
SITA's chairperson gave 313,866 users registered on the e-Gov portal, 13,751 registering in December 2023, and 1.3 million users as at October 2023.
Home Affairs says its new portal on Myhomeaffairsonline for recording an intention to apply for asylum is live for a first batch of test cases, with public intake after the next weekend release.
